POVA Curve 5G (Geek Black, 8GB+256GB)

Product description

At the heart of our innovation lies the 3B vision – Best Design, Best Signal, and Best AI – a philosophy that powers our all-new Starship Design smartphone. Crafted for those who demand the extraordinary, it features a stunning 144Hz Curved AMOLED display encased in an ultra-slim 7.45mm body, all while housing a massive 5500mAh battery – proving that style and substance can truly coexist. Redefining connectivity, it offers No Network Communication*, VoWiFi Dual Band, and the Intelligent Signal Hub System to ensure seamless communication even without cellular coverage – delivering on our promise of the Best Signal. The experience is further elevated by BetteraskElla, a powerful AI assistant with support for Indian languages like Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, and Gujarati, representing our commitment to Best AI – AI that truly understands you. Powering it all is the D7300 Ultimate 5G Processor, with up to 16GB RAM (Memory Fusion) and 256GB ROM, ensuring smooth performance, while TÜV SÜD certification guarantees 72 months of lag-free experience. With a 64MP Sony IMX682 rear camera, 13MP front camera, IP64 rating, 45W fast charger included, and Dolby Atmos audio, the Pova Curve 5G isn’t just another smartphone – it’s a leap forward, bringing our 3B vision to life.
